params.message:
Cite a PDF by its link in the Studio, not only a web page

"Paste a link" refused any response that was not HTML, XML or plain
text, so a trend report linked as a PDF could not be cited. A PDF is now
fetched under the same public-web checks (up to 40 MB, since a PDF cut
short cannot be read), its title, subject, date and page count read with
pdfinfo and its text with pdftotext, and it comes in as a raw signal
under "Cited by the author" like a page. Up to 60,000 characters of the
text are kept so the review gate can retrace a claim that is not on the
cover.

Portal: A trend report linked as a PDF can now be cited as a source in the Studio.
